title: reComputer Mini J501 Edge AI computer features NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64GB/32GB module, two FAKRA camera connectors

content:
Designed for robotics applications, the reComputer Mini J501 is an Edge AI computer powered by an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 64GB or 32GB module, delivering up ot 275 TOPS of AI performance. The computer features 10GbE and GbE RJ45 ports, HDMI 2.1 video output, two USB 3.2 ports, two USB 2.0 Type-C Debug/Recovery ports, a 128 M.2 NVMe SSD, two FAKRA connectors for up to eight GMSL2 cameras, and a range of other I/O connectors. reComputer Mini J501 specifications: System-on-module (one or the other) NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 32GB  (reComputer Mini J5011 model) CPU – 8-core Arm Cortex-A78AE v8.2 64-bit processor @ 2.2 GHz with 2MB L2 + 4MB L3 cache GPU and AI NVIDIA Ampere architecture with 1792 NVIDIA CUDA cores and 56 Tensor Cores @ 930 MHz DL Accelerator – 2x NVDLA Engines @ up to 1.4 GHz Up to 200 TOPS Video Encode – 1x 4K60 | 3x 4K30 [...]
